voice_policy: plain modern English, second person, present tense; no promises of results; quotes only from the linked spans (≤ 25 words); Pali shown on screen, never spoken by TTS

lines.text: Sit upright. Half-lotus if it suits you, right leg on the left, hands palm-up, right on left. Or any steady seat.
Body straight. Mind on the task in front of you.
Bring your palms together in front of the heart, and recall the qualities of the Buddha, the Dhamma and the Sangha.
The Buddha is my mainstay.
The Dhamma is my mainstay.
The Sangha is my mainstay.
In your mind: buddho, buddho. Dhammo, dhammo. Sangho, sangho.
lines.say: In your mind. Buddho, buddho. Dhammo, dhammo. Sangho, sangho.

lines.text: Hands back in your lap. Silently, three times: buddho.
Breathing in, think “bud”…

inferred.note: “at your own pace”: the orb's pace is our guide, not the text's

lines.text: …breathing out, “dho”. Ten breaths, at your own pace.
Now “buddho” on the in-breath…
…and “buddho” on the out-breath. Seven breaths.
Now one “buddho” for each whole breath, in and out. Five breaths.
Now “buddho” three times in each breath. Three breaths.
Stop counting. Just “bud” on the in-breath, “dho” on the out.
Let the breath be relaxed and natural.
Keep the mind still, with the breath at the nostrils.
As it goes out, don't send the mind out after it. As it comes in, don't follow it in.
Let your awareness be broad, cheerful, and open.
Don't force the mind. Relax.
Imagine you're breathing out into the wide open air.
Be like a post at the edge of the sea. The tide rises and falls; the post doesn't move.
Bud… dho. Still, like the post.
When you're this still, let go of “buddho”.
Simply feel the breath itself.
Now inward: the tip of the nose…
…and slowly up to the middle of the forehead.
Keep your awareness broad.
Rest a moment at the forehead, then come back to the nose.
Now back and forth, nose to forehead, like climbing up and down a mountain. Seven times.
Settle at the forehead. Don't go back to the nose.
Move up to the middle of the top of the head, and settle there.
Breathe in there; let it spread through the head…
…then return to the forehead.
Back and forth between the forehead and the top of the head. Seven times.
Finally, rest on the top of the head.
Now into the centre of the brain…
…be still a moment, then back to the top of the head.
Back and forth between these two spots: the top, and the middle.
Finally, settle in the middle of the brain.
Keep your awareness broad.
Let the refined breath in the head spread down to the lower body.

inferred.note: in the text these follow the light sign; here they are for the breath alone

lines.text: Keep awareness still and expansive. Let the refined breath fill the whole body.
Stay with the whole body breathing, as long as you like.
